title.description: A short descriptive title for the list extracted from the image.

item_number.description: The numbering or bullet marker of this item as it appears in the image (e.g. "1", "a", "i", "*").

text.description: The primary text content of the list item.

amount.description: A monetary value, quantity, or numeric measurement associated with the item, if present in the image. Null when absent.

notes.description: Any secondary detail, comment, sub-bullet, or annotation attached to the item. Null when absent.
